integrity: Analytical support-function proof and separately runnable finite numerical cross-check; no exhaustive computational proof is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The calculation treats translations of strictly positive real part and nonzero imaginary part on half-plane weighted Bergman Hilbert spaces, not arbitrary affine or weighted composition operators. It determines the maximal centered disk by a unique transcendental equation rather than an elementary formula; uncountably many boundary points are not attained.
title: Sharp centered-disk radius and the one-chord boundary of half-plane translation numerical ranges
